theme.title: Past Meets Present

questions.prompt: What was Allen Iverson's scoring average during his 2000–01 MVP season?
questions.note: 31.1, and Iverson led the NBA in steals too, the scoring-and-steals double in his MVP year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: All-Star guard Allen Iverson averaged 31.1 points, 4.6 assists and 2.5 steals per game

funFacts.text: Iverson led the NBA not only in scoring but also in steals that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading the league in both scoring and steals

funFacts.text: Iverson also won All-Star Game MVP in Washington, D.C., where the East beat the West by a single point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iverson scored 25 points along with 5 assists and 4 steals, and was named the All-Star Game Most Valuable Player

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had an unusual awards sweep: teammate Aaron McKie was Sixth Man of the Year and Mutombo was Defensive Player of the Year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Aaron McKie provided the team with 11.6 points, 5.0 assists and 1.4 steals per game, and was named the NBA Sixth Man of the Year

questions.prompt: The chart shows four other famous regular-season scoring nights. How many did Michael Jordan score in his 1990 career high at Cleveland?
questions.context: Chicago Bulls at Cleveland Cavaliers · March 28, 1990
questions.note: 69 in a 117–113 road win, the most of his career, in a season he led the NBA at 33.6 a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On March 28, 1990, Jordan scored a career-high 69 points in a 117–113 road win over the Cavaliers.

funFacts.text: Jordan led the league that season at 33.6 points a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaged a league-leading 33.6 ppg on 52.6% shooting, to go with 6.9 rpg and 6.3 apg

funFacts.text: It was Phil Jackson's first season coaching the Bulls.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: under the guidance of new coach Phil Jackson

funFacts.text: Chicago's season again ended against Detroit, for the third straight year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls lost to the Pistons for the third consecutive season

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 1994 East finals at Madison Square Garden, how many fourth-quarter points did Reggie Miller score?
questions.context: 1994 East finals · Game 5 · at New York
questions.note: 25 of his 39, while jawing with Spike Lee courtside; New York won the last two games and the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 39 points (25 in the fourth quarter alone) in the Pacers' 93–86 victory

funFacts.text: Director Spike Lee was seated courtside at Madison Square Garden, and Miller talked animatedly at him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: engaged in an animated discussion of his ongoing performance with noted Knicks fan Spike Lee

funFacts.text: That explosive road performance put the Pacers ahead in the series, but the Knicks ultimately eliminated Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: but they lost the next two games and the series

funFacts.text: The player later earned the nickname 'Knick Killer' for his repeated postseason torment of New York.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: most notably against the New York Knicks, for which he earned the nickname "Knick Killer"

questions.prompt: LeBron once scored 46% of Cleveland's points in a playoff loss. What share of Golden State's 105 did Curry score at New York in 2013?
questions.context: Golden State Warriors · at New York · February 27, 2013
questions.note: 51%: 54 of the Warriors' 105 points, more than all his teammates combined.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On February 27, 2013, Stephen Curry scored 54 points but his Warriors lost to the Knicks, 109–105.
source.derivation: Curry 54 of Golden State's 105 points: 54 / 105 × 100 = 51.4%, rounded to 51%.

funFacts.text: Steph hit 11 three-pointers against New York.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: making a Warriors franchise-record 11 three-pointers on 11 of 13 shooting from 3-point range

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He shot 18 for 28 from the field

funFacts.text: New York won despite Curry's scoring display.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: his Warriors lost to the Knicks, 109–105
